notes: Adds a read-only local Support View at http://127.0.0.1:53685 so Recruitment Hub live state can be inspected safely through Opera Browser Connector. It exposes only candidate names/statuses/MBL IDs and workflow metadata needed for diagnostics, binds to this PC only, and provides no write controls. Existing recruitment, Contracts Test, Onboarding Test and MBL workflow are unchanged. This build is for live MBL ↔ Hub cross-checking.
